scope.generatedFrom: Current Axum Router mounts in candidate services plus canonical apps/backend authorization expectations.

classificationDefinitions.public-allowlist: Explicitly approved anonymous endpoint; only the enumerated method and path may bypass authentication.
classificationDefinitions.authenticated-user: Valid canonical access token required; response or mutation is scoped to the authenticated subject where applicable.
classificationDefinitions.owner-only: Valid canonical access token plus server-side comparison between the token subject/wallet and stored or derived ownership.
classificationDefinitions.permission-specific-admin-operator: Valid canonical access token plus the exact granular backend permission; admin role/name alone is insufficient.
classificationDefinitions.internal-webhook: External user credentials are insufficient; require signed webhook material or authenticated service/operator identity.
classificationDefinitions.unknown: Policy is unresolved or wildcard-mixed; target behavior is fail closed until split and classified.

identityContract.audience: exact service or approved BFF audience; wrong audience denied
identityContract.ownershipRule: derive subject/wallet from verified claims and compare server-side; never trust body/query/path alone

anchors: Add a public-route allowlist; everything else is protected by default.

evidenceResolution: For every route, the evidence location is its parent service.source and the exact route.routeAnchor substring. canonicalEvidence entries provide backend or handler-policy anchors.
